name: @epoch/simulation-fabric
description: Epoch Simulation Execution Fabric kernel (W021) — the typed, versioned, provider-neutral EXECUTION fabric over @epoch/simulation-protocol (W005): simulation-job submission with deterministic content-addressed run identity (digest over canonical invocation payload, W006-evidence conventions), typed idempotency keys (replayed submission -> same run identity via the typed duplicate-run admission; different content under the same key -> idempotency-conflict), execution planning with capability bindings as opaque typed references to W007 registrations (never structural copies), the sealed append-only run state machine (W023 version-chain style: previousRunDigest chaining, content-addressed states, submitted -> scheduled -> running -> completed | failed | cancelled), result ingestion through the REAL W005 admission + conformance pipelines, the simulation:* event vocabulary over the W010 event shapes (one run = one stream, stream:simulation-<suffix>), tenant-scoped runs with typed tenant-isolation-rejected gates, and the SimulationExecutionPort adapter seam with ONE in-memory reference adapter (external grids/clouds are adapters, NEVER core types). In-memory reference machinery only: NO persistence, NO network, NO clocks (instants are caller-supplied).
